payload: direction, method, status, Call-ID hash, CSeq, Via branch hash
overhead: single binary event after parser success; no string formatting
notes: Primary receive boundary for black-box packet to white-box transaction correlation.

phase: after new_t succeeds and before init_rb/return
timing: same monotonic tick as transaction creation
payload: transaction pointer id, method class, initial RFC state

phase: after RFC3261 magic-cookie branch lookup path is selected
payload: method class, branch hash, sent-by hash, lookup result
overhead: one compact event only on match/mismatch boundary

phase: after SEND_PR_BUFFER for stored reply retransmission succeeds
payload: status class, branch, transaction id, send result
notes: Do not treat function entry as already sent.

phase: after upstream response is matched to client transaction
overhead: one event per matched upstream response

phase: when relay_reply classifies response and commits stored UAS status
payload: status code/class, branch, decision, stored uas.status
overhead: classification-only; actual send is emitted by HK_SEND_PR_BUFFER

phase: after msg_send returns success for reply/request buffer
payload: direction, method/status, transport, buffer kind, branch
overhead: one compact event after send success; payload stores status class not reason phrase

payload: CANCEL transaction id, original INVITE transaction id if any, match flag

phase: after original INVITE is marked canceled and before branch cancels/replies
payload: original transaction id, cancel transaction id, branch mask, last_received summary

phase: before/after local branch CANCEL decision and SEND_BUFFER
payload: branch id, last_received, force flag, send result
overhead: hot path emits only decision bitset and status

phase: after timer_add succeeds and rb->timer.t_active is set
timing: logical deadline tick stored with current monotonic base
payload: timer kind, timeout ms, fr_expire, retr_expire
overhead: emit successful arm only; no JSON/string formatting
notes: ProfuzzBench patch disables timer processes, so callback observation needs reference profile.

phase: after timer_del/flag mutation for response/request buffer
payload: timer kind, transaction id, buffer role
overhead: macro hook must be compiled as inline binary emission

phase: after wait_timer is added and wait_start stored
notes: Used to distinguish legal wait/termination from early discard.

payload: hash index, branch id, method class, callid hash
